name: UniPi
summary: UniPi reframes policy learning as text-conditioned video generation: a diffusion model synthesizes a video of the robot completing the instruction, and a small inverse-dynamics model extracts the actions that realize those frames. Because video is a universal interface, the planner can absorb internet video and transfer across embodiments, with the action decoder being the only embodiment-specific part.
innovation: Video as an embodiment-agnostic planning representation, decoupled from action decoding.
Lets internet-scale video pretraining serve control directly.
matters: Founded the video-generation-as-planning line running through GR-2, Genie and Cosmos-style systems.
limits: Video generation is slow and physically inconsistent; hallucinated frames yield unexecutable plans.
lineage: World modeling in pixel space, with planning done by generation rather than search.
